english translation text: THE LADY WHO TAUGHT THE WORLD ABOUT HIJAB

arabic text: PARDA DUNIYA KO SIKHAANE WALI\nAAYI BAZAARON MEIN ZAINAB
english translation text: THE LADY WHO TAUGHT THE WORLD ABOUT HIJAB\nHAS BEEN BROUGHT INTO THE BAZAAR

arabic text: GHAR SE BAHAR BHI NA AANE WALI\nAAYI BAZAARON MEIN ZAINAB
english translation text: THE ONE WHO NEVER STEPPED OUT OF HER HOUSE\nWITHOUT A VEIL HAS BEEN BROUGHT INTO THE BAZAAR

arabic text: JISNE BABA SE CHHURA-E-THE KAHI BAAR ASEER\nQAIDI AZAAD KARANE WALI\nAAYI BAZAARON MEIN ZAINAB
english translation text: THE ONE WHO USED TO ASK\nHER FATHER TO FREE THE PRISONERS\nHAS BEEN BROUGHT INTO THE BAZAAR

arabic text: JALTE KHAIMON SE UTHA LAYI ABBAS KE BAAD\nALI AABID KO BACHANE WALI\nAAYI BAZAARON MEIN ZAINAB
english translation text: FROM THE BURNING TENTS, SHE WAS THE\nONE, AFTER ABBAS LEFT, WHO SAVED IMAM SAJJAD,\nSHE HAS BEEN BROUGHT INTO THE BAZAAR

arabic text: DEEN KI KHAATIR YE BIBI SAALAR BANI\nBAN KE ABBAS DIKHAANE WALI\nAAYI BAZAARON MEIN ZAINAB
english translation text: FOR THE SAKE OF THE RELIGION SHE BECAME THE PROTECTOR,\nTHE ONE WHO TOOK THE PLACE OF ABBAS,\nSHE HAS BEEN BROUGHT INTO THE BAZAAR

arabic text: APNE SEENAY PE SAKINA KO ZINDANON MEIN\nBAAD BHAYI KE SULAANE WALI\nAAYI BAZAARON MEIN ZAINAB
english translation text: IN THE PRISON SHE KEPT SAKINA ON HER CHEST,\nAFTER HER BROTHER SHE WAS THE ONE WHO MADE SAKINA SLEEP,\nSHE HAS BEEN BROUGHT INTO THE BAZAAR

arabic text: NANGE SAR PARTI RAHI KHUTBE BAZAARON MEIN\nKASRE DUSHMAN KO HILANE WALI\nAAYI BAZAARON MEIN ZAINAB
english translation text: SHE DELIVERED A SERMON IN THE BAZAAR IN HER HELPLESS CONDITION,\nTHE ONE WHO SHOOK THE ENEMY\nHAS BEEN BROUGHT INTO THE BAZAAR
